# Third-party attribution — Dark Reader

`src/lib/content/modify-colors.ts` and `src/lib/content/images.ts` are adaptations
of color-modification and image-analysis ideas from **Dark Reader**
(https://github.com/darkreader/darkreader), used under the MIT License.

They are focused re-implementations of the concepts (HSL lightness mapping with
hue preservation; pixel-sampled dark/light/transparent image classification),
not line-for-line ports, but credit is due to the Dark Reader authors.
